title.zh: France proposes liability for crypto exchanges offering DeFi access
title.en: France proposes liability for crypto exchanges offering DeFi access

current_state.zh: French authorities proposed revising EU MiCA rules so crypto exchanges that facilitate access to DeFi protocols must vet them and could be held liable for certain customer losses.
